Senior Backend Engineer, Disbursement Systems (TS/SCI)

Kestrel Ridge Federal | Alpharetta, GA (hybrid) | Full-time

About Kestrel Ridge Federal

Kestrel Ridge Federal builds and operates secure software for federal agencies and defense customers. Our Financial Systems division modernizes the platforms government programs use to move money: grant disbursements, contractor payments and benefit payouts. We bring commercial engineering practices (cloud-native services, CI/CD, automated testing) into classified and controlled environments.

About the team

The Disbursement Systems team is replacing a decades-old batch payment system with event-driven services that record every payment in a double-entry ledger and reconcile daily against Treasury and bank records. The program is in its second year. You'll join a team of nine engineers working out of our Alpharetta facility, which includes an accredited SCIF.

The role

We're looking for a senior backend engineer with experience in payments or ledger systems to help design and build the new disbursement platform, lead data migration from the legacy system, and set engineering standards for the program.

What you'll do

- Design and build backend services in Go and Java that process and record government disbursements
- Model payment flows as balanced ledger entries with full audit history
- Lead the backfill and reconciliation of historical payment records from the legacy batch system
- Build daily reconciliation against Treasury and bank settlement files, and tooling to investigate breaks
- Write design documents and support security accreditation (ATO) packages for new services
- Mentor mid-level engineers and participate in code review
- Support production operations, including an on-call rotation during disbursement windows

What you'll bring

- Active TS/SCI clearance, required at the start of employment. We cannot sponsor a new clearance or reinstate an inactive one for this position
- US citizenship (required for the clearance)
- 8+ years of backend software engineering experience
- Experience with payments, ledgers, billing or other financial systems
- Strong experience with PostgreSQL or another relational database, including large data migrations
- Proficiency in Go or Java; experience with event streaming (Kafka or similar)
- Familiarity with secure development practices and working in regulated environments

Nice to have

- Prior experience on defense or federal programs
- Experience with ACH, wire or Treasury payment formats
- Experience supporting ATO packages under NIST 800-53
- Experience with Kubernetes in an air-gapped or restricted environment

Compensation

The salary range for this position is $188,000 to $226,000 base, depending on experience and clearance level. Benefits include medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k) with a 6% company match, tuition assistance and a clearance maintenance bonus.

Location and travel

This is a hybrid role based in Alpharetta, GA. Because much of the work is classified, expect to be on site in the SCIF at least three days a week; unclassified work may be done remotely on the remaining days. Occasional travel to customer sites in the Washington, DC area, under 5%.

Security clearance

Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. An active TS/SCI clearance is required on day one; this position is not open to candidates whose clearance has lapsed or who are pending investigation.

Kestrel Ridge Federal is an equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans.
